summary: This is a DSH plugin that adds a sidebar for browsing workspace files, previews common formats, shows session-produced/modified files, and lets users drag files or folders into the conversation as path text.

classificationSuggestion.reason: The plugin’s primary user-facing purpose is a workspace file navigation and preview sidebar in DSH. Evidence shows it provides a docked file panel with directory browsing, multi-format file previewing, and session-produced file listing, while also enabling drag-and-drop insertion of file/folder paths into the chat input. Core behavior is UI- and workspace-focused with limited stated capabilities centered on browsing and reading workspace file content.
